purpose: Pair a frozen-M arm with a fixed two-step online-M arm over the complete registered metadata clocks to measure causal policy and version-history effects of M updates.
selection_rule: Run both arms over the same two frozen policy-order videos and every metadata clock frame; initialize both arms with the same seed and update only the online arm at the first two eligible fixed-scope M opportunities, without selecting an arm or stopping on an outcome.
interpretation: This is a fixed paired intervention diagnostic for whether online M updates alter a causal anonymous policy and its append-only version history on policy Train cache. It is not a self-correcting-memory acceptance, predicted-track training, an OCD/MOT metric, or Goal A/B/C acceptance.
